They must understand the importance of preserving the original system state, including operating system installations, disk structures, configuration data, and application dependencies. Experience working with unstable or ageing storage media is essential. The candidate must understand the risks associated with imaging deteriorating disks, including read errors, data loss, and the potential impact of repeated imaging attempts. They must be able to select appropriate imaging strategies that prioritize data preservation and minimise the risk of further degradation. Legacy Operating System Conversion The candidate must have demonstrable experience converting physical Windows XP and Windows 7 installations into virtual machines running on modern hypervisors. This includes performing physical-to-virtual migrations, resolving driver incompatibilities, addressing hardware dependencies, and ensuring that the migrated operating system retains the functionality required by the legacy application. A strong understanding of legacy Windows environments and the differences between physical and virtualized hardware is essential. The candidate must be able to investigate and resolve issues arising from changes in storage controllers, network interfaces, processor configurations, peripheral connections, and other hardware-dependent components. Hypervisor Configuration and Virtual Machine Optimization The candidate must have hands-on experience administering Proxmox and/or VMware ESXi in production environments. They must be capable of configuring and optimizing virtual machines for applications with specific legacy requirements, rather than relying solely on standard virtual machine configurations. Relevant experience includes CPU pinning, serial and COM-port emulation, time synchronization, I/O scheduling, and other virtual machine tuning techniques. The candidate must understand how these settings can influence application behaviour, timing, communication with external equipment, and overall system stability. The objective is to establish a virtualized environment that preserves the operational characteristics of the original system while providing a maintainable and supportable infrastructure. Backup, Monitoring, and Recovery The candidate must have experience implementing enterprise backup and monitoring solutions for business-critical or operationally critical systems. This includes developing and validating backup strategies, monitoring system health, and establishing reliable recovery procedures. A key requirement is the ability to design recovery scenarios that can be executed by personnel without specialist engineering knowledge. Procedures must be clearly documented, repeatable, and tested to minimise downtime and reduce dependency on individual technical experts. The resulting environment must support predictable recovery following hardware failures, virtual machine corruption, configuration errors, or other operational incidents. Additional Qualifications Experience with high-availability architectures, virtual machine replication, and failover configurations is considered an advantage. Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and recovery-time requirements for critical operational systems would also be beneficial. The candidate must be comfortable working within an isolated IT environment where external network access, cloud-based services, and online support resources may be unavailable or prohibited. review_candidates.title: Assistant General Manager
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity  SLO is looking for a senior leader who can own Philippine Operations today and grow into a broader business executive as the company expands. We want someone with a strong foundation in BPO, outsourcing, shared services, service delivery, managed services or technology-enabled operations - and the potential and attitude to carry a much bigger part of the business.  Beyond Operations, the AGM will progressively help lead client management, business solutions, white-label and technology partnerships, new service development, account economics and commercial decisions. The role works within SLO's senior leadership structure, including the CEO, COO, and the company's other Philippine leadership anchor.  What You Will Own  Lead Philippine Operations, service delivery, managers, KPIs, quality and major client escalations.  Build scalable operating systems and develop strong Operations leaders.  Work with senior Sales leadership on complex opportunities, solution design, feasibility, pricing logic, and implementation.  Translate client problems into practical people, process and technology solutions.  Lead or coordinate white-label, technology and development partnerships and help create new managed-service offerings.  Understand account economics and participate in proposals, renewals, expansion and strategic client decisions.  Collaborate across HR, Finance, Accounting, Legal/Compliance and Corporate Services.  Make sound independent decisions, knowing when CEO or COO involvement is truly required.  Progressively assume broader responsibility for the Philippine business as capability and results are demonstrated.  What Will Matter Most  Relevant senior leadership experience may come from BPO, outsourcing, shared services, service delivery, customer or technology operations, managed services or business solutions. Previous AGM/GM title is not required. Title matters less than capability, potential and attitude.  Leadership potential - the capacity to grow beyond the function you already know.  Attitude, humility and learning agility - willingness to learn, accept coaching and lead specialists who may know more than you.  Executive judgment and independence - ability to solve consequential problems without escalating everything upward.  Builder mentality - comfort creating systems, capabilities and services that do not yet exist. Commercial curiosity - desire to understand how customers are won, solutions are designed, accounts make money and businesses grow.  Hands-on leadership - willingness to roll up your sleeves in an entrepreneurial environment.  Sales Leadership - Important Distinction  This is not primarily a sales position. SLO will have senior Sales leadership responsible for prospecting, hunting, pipeline, negotiation, closing and revenue production. The AGM's role is to help ensure that what Sales sells can be designed, priced, implemented and delivered successfully - and to lead strong specialists without needing to be the expert in every room.  Why This Role Is Different  The successful candidate will gain exposure across Operations, Clients, Sales, Technology, White Label Partnerships, Business Solutions, New Services, Commercial Strategy and Organizational Growth. For the right person, this is not simply the next Operations job; it is an opportunity to develop into a well-rounded business executive and help carry SLO's next stage of growth.  Compensation & Application  Competitive executive compensation, commensurate with experience, leadership capability, market value, and scope of responsibility.  Application Requirements Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a brief cover letter addressing the following question: “What greater responsibility or challenge are you ready to take on beyond your current role, and why do you believe you are prepared for it?” We encourage applicants to share relevant experiences, achievements, and personal strengths that demonstrate their readiness to take the next step in their professional journey.
